court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Civil Judge Senior Division, Warora, Case No. unknown
case_name: Sachinsingh Baldeosingh Chauhan vs Sau. Rajeshwari W/O. Sachinsingh

parties.respondent_defendant: Sau. Rajeshwari w/o Sachinsingh Chauhan, wife, service

facts_of_case: Petitioner and respondent are well-qualified persons who got married in 2008 but couldn't live together peacefully. Respondent left the matrimonial home and started residing with her parents. Petitioner challenges the trial court's order allowing maintenance pendente lite and litigation expenses.

legal_principles.principle: The amount of maintenance awarded should not be exorbitant and heavily burdensome.
legal_principles.held: a of Rs. 6,000/- per month is the amount in exorbitant and heavily burdensome amount on the petitioner

legal_principles.principle: A well-qualified lady is expected to support herself and her family.
legal_principles.held: the respondent-wife was unable to continue with the work of Lecturer because of the family responsibilities

legal_principles.principle: The status of the parties and their living standards should be considered while determining maintenance.
legal_principles.held: considering the status of the parties and more particularly, the respondent-wife's status being a well qualified lady

outcome.final_order: The final court order modified the trial court's decision, directing the husband to pay a different amount of maintenance pendente lite and litigation charges.
